paper_record.title: Quaternion-Kahler geometry of time reversal symmetric crystals
paper_record.abstract: Quantum geometry reveals how the shape of Bloch wave functions governs correlated quantum phenomena. Its standard formulation describes isolated complex bands, where Berry curvature is Abelian and ideal geometry is Kahler. However, time reversal symmetric crystals with spin require a different language since Kramers degeneracy pairs Bloch states and turns Berry curvature into a non-Abelian SU(2) field. Here we show that Kramers pair band geometry is quaternionic. A minimal Kramers pair defines a map into quaternion projective space, and its quaternionic quantum geometric tensor unifies the quantum metric with the three SU(2) Berry curvature components. The non-negativity of this tensor imposes local metric-curvature inequalities, whose saturation defines the non-Abelian counterpart of ideal Chern bands. In four dimensions, the ideal limit further yields an algebraic structure related to the four-dimensional quantum Hall effect. Our results promote ideal quantum geometry from the Abelian geometry of Chern bands to the quaternionic, non-Abelian geometry of time reversal symmetric quantum matter.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文证明了具有时间反演对称性的Kramers简并能带的量子几何本质上是四元数几何（四元数-Kähler几何），并推导出了相应的局部度规-曲率不等式。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper demonstrates that the quantum geometry of time-reversal symmetric Kramers pairs is fundamentally quaternionic (quaternion-Kähler geometry) and derives the corresponding local metric-curvature bounds.

problem.zh: 传统的量子几何（如Kähler几何）仅适用于描述孤立的单带系统（阿贝尔Berry曲率），而无法直接应用于具有Kramers简并和非阿贝尔SU(2) Berry曲率的时间反演对称自旋晶体。
problem.en: Traditional quantum geometry (Kähler geometry) only describes isolated single bands with Abelian Berry curvature, failing to naturally capture time-reversal symmetric spinful crystals with Kramers degeneracy and non-Abelian SU(2) Berry curvature.

approach.zh: 将Kramers简并对映射到四元数射影空间，定义了统一量子度规与三个非阿贝尔Berry曲率分量的四元数量子几何张量（QQGT），并利用其半正定性推导出了局部度规-曲率不等式，最后通过格点模型和第一性原理计算（Na3Bi）进行了验证。
approach.en: By mapping Kramers pairs to quaternion projective space, the authors define a quaternionic quantum geometric tensor (QQGT) that unifies the quantum metric and three non-Abelian Berry curvature components, derive local metric-curvature inequalities from its positive semidefiniteness, and validate them using lattice models and DFT calculations of Na3Bi.

main_takeaway.zh: 时间反演对称能带的理想极限由四元数-Kähler几何描述，其局部度规-曲率边界的饱和定义了非阿贝尔理想能带，这为寻找分数拓扑绝缘体提供了新的几何判据。
main_takeaway.en: The ideal limit of time-reversal symmetric bands is governed by quaternion-Kähler geometry, where the saturation of local metric-curvature bounds defines non-Abelian ideal bands, offering a new geometric design principle for fractional topological insulators.

why_it_matters.zh: 它将理想量子几何的研究范式从阿贝尔陈能带推广到了非阿贝尔、时间反演对称的量子物质中，为在晶体中设计和实现分数自旋霍尔效应等强关联拓扑物态奠定了理论基础。
why_it_matters.en: It extends the paradigm of ideal quantum geometry from Abelian Chern bands to non-Abelian, time-reversal symmetric quantum matter, laying a theoretical foundation for designing and realizing fractional spin Hall effects and other strongly correlated topological phases in crystals.

reason.zh: 建立了描述Kramers简并能带的完整四元数几何框架，成功将陈能带的经典Kähler几何推广到了时间反演对称系统。
reason.en: It establishes a complete quaternionic geometric framework for Kramers-degenerate bands, successfully generalizing the classic Kähler geometry of Chern bands to time-reversal symmetric systems.

reason.zh: 该工作在凝聚态物理的量子几何领域取得了基础性的理论突破，并结合了紧束缚模型与第一性原理计算，非常符合PRL的定位。
reason.en: This work presents a foundational theoretical breakthrough in the quantum geometry of condensed matter physics, combined with tight-binding models and DFT calculations, making it highly suitable for PRL.
